page.title: Request an event drape estimate
page.description: Share your venue, event type, and draping goals. Our team reviews your brief and follows up with a tailored rental estimate conversation.
page.studioPromo: Want to sketch your room first? Use Studio to add drape runs and preview in 3D — then return here to submit your brief.
page.metaDescription: Request a luxury event drape rental estimate in Montreal — share venue details, draping goals, measurements, and fabric preferences.
